config.purpose: Make the image views vote on the IDENTITY, not only on the gating score. Every branch (EEG + three image branches) emits a nearest-prototype identity and its own distance margins (d1, d2). Five fixed identity-fusion candidates and three fixed gating candidates are compared. The point of the round is the LABEL-FREE part: closed-set identity ability (LOSO fold-wise macro-F1 / accuracy, train-domain OOF macro-F1), branch agreement, and Test cluster purity / coverage. No session information is used to decide an identity, and Test labels do not exist.

predecessors.eeg_branch: E233 mean_align: E227 deploy_auc2_lofo.pt frozen representation (10 blocks, sqrt(w), task-wise standardisation, PCA96) + k=12 prototypes per (task, identity) + symmetric per-(session, task) batch-mean alignment. Read only.
predecessors.image_views: E149 pixel views (32x32x3 = 3072); the scoring harness is the E237 image_component (task-wise standardisation on the fit rows -> PCA96 -> k=12 prototypes -> negative nearest distance -> the same batch-mean alignment).
predecessors.purity: E232 / E233 label-free Test session2 k-means purity (k=20) in the frozen baseline EEG PCA space.
predecessors.writes: research/E238_multiview_identity_fusion/ only; no historical experiment is modified.

closed_set_identity_reference.note: reference only; E238 recomputes the closed-set F1 for its own branches with the 20-fold LOSO protocol below.

protocol.task_standardisation: per-task mean/std of the fit rows (all 20 identities, trial fraction <= 0.6), applied to Train and Test (E228 rule). Also used for the image views (E237 rule).
protocol.prototype_init: random sample init, seed = 17 * identity, 20 Lloyd iterations (E143/E237 harness).
protocol.eeg_branch: frozen E227 deploy model: state['p'] (960 prototypes) and state['keys'] (task, identity). Nothing refitted.
protocol.alignment: E233 mean_align in each branch's own space: z <- z - mean(z | session, task) + mu_ref(task), mu_ref(task) = fit-row mean of the task. One identical rule for both sessions, min_cell_n = 200. Session is only a batch key: it never selects an identity and never gates a sample. Train rows (OOF / LOSO) are single-session and are not aligned.
protocol.closed_set_loso: 20 folds, one held-out identity each: prototypes built from the ENROLLED identities' fit rows; identity predicted on the eval window (trial fraction in (0.6, 0.8]) rows of the enrolled identities (the `known` rows); macro-F1 / accuracy computed there. The held-out identity rows are used only for the open-set rejection read-out, never for the F1.
protocol.train_oof: inner 5-block OOF on the fit rows (blocks = floor(5 * trial_fraction) clipped to [0, 4]); prototypes built on the other 4 blocks; all 20 identities; macro-F1 over all fit rows.

EEG.source: E233 mean_align (aligned Test score/pred read from cache; identity distances recomputed from the frozen prototypes)

IMG_px_all.definition: composite of the 7 E149 pixel views (X_correlation, X_covariance5, X_covariance_hr, X_topomap5, X_mw_corr8, X_mw_cov4, X_mw_cov8); per-view scores are z-scored with the fit-row OOF reference and averaged (the E149 / E237 definition). Its per-identity distance matrix is the mean of the per-view z-scored per-identity distance matrices, which is the same affine-then-average operation.

branch_outputs.per_row: id_b = argmin over the 20 identities of the minimum distance to that identity's k=12 prototypes of the row's task; d1_b = that minimum distance; d2_b = the smallest distance to a prototype of a DIFFERENT identity.
branch_outputs.note: All distances are Euclidean in the branch's own PCA96 space (96 dims, so no distance-concentration correction).

candidates.eeg_only: BASELINE; must reproduce the E233 mean_align pred row for row.
candidates.vote_equal: the 4 branch identities vote with equal weight 0.25; the winner is the identity with the largest vote share.
candidates.vote_weighted: the 4 branch identities vote with the fixed weights above.
candidates.rank_sum_identity: inside each row the 20 per-identity distances of each branch are replaced by their rank (1 = nearest); the fixed weighted sum of ranks is minimised.
candidates.eeg_plus_best_img: rank-sum rule restricted to EEG and IMG_px_all, 0.5 / 0.5.

identity_fusion.tie_break: ties are broken by the EEG branch d1 (the identity that is nearest in the EEG branch wins), fixed before the run for all vote candidates; the rank-sum candidates reduce to a continuous score and have no ties in practice.
identity_fusion.oob_rule: if a branch's predicted identity is not in the enrolled set of a LOSO fold it cannot happen: every branch only scores the fold's enrolled prototypes, so all votes are inside the enrolled set.

candidates.gate_score_fused: CONTROL: the E237 fuse_zscore_50_50 Test score (cache), unchanged; tau from the LOSO unknown quantile at rejection 0.90, S1 gate = 0.95 quantile of the S1 scores.

gate_agreement.agreement_score: 1 - P(vote_entropy), where vote_entropy = -sum_i p_i log p_i over the identities with p_i = (weighted vote share of identity i) / (sum of the 4 branch weights), normalised by log(4) so it lies in [0, 1]; 0 = all four branches agree.
gate_agreement.percentile_rule: P(x) = per-task percentile of x inside the population being scored (Test rows for Test, that fold's eval rows for LOSO), ties get the mid-rank. Both components are monotone transforms of their own values, so P() cannot change a component's own AUC; it only puts the two components on one [0, 1] scale. A fit-row inner-OOF reference was rejected because the aligned Test fused score sits entirely below that reference, which compresses P(fused) into [0, 0.01] and lets the entropy term dominate by construction.

candidates.gate_agreement_threshold_sweep: CURVE ONLY: the gate_agreement score with tau swept over 200 quantiles of the S1 scores in [0.50, 0.999]; S1 rejection and S2 acceptance are reported as arrays. No point is selected.

gating.loso_gate: tau = 90th percentile of the pooled LOSO unknown scores (unknown rejection = 0.90, the compliant operating point).
gating.s1_gate_095: tau = 95th percentile of the candidate's Test S1 scores -> S1 rejection 0.95 exactly; read S2 acceptance.

label_free_primary.closed_set_loso_macro_f1: per-fold macro-F1 over the enrolled identities on the eval-window known rows; reported as mean +- std over 20 folds and as the pooled value
label_free_primary.train_oof_macro_f1: inner 5-block OOF on the fit rows, all 20 identities
label_free_primary.branch_agreement: share of rows on which each pair of the 4 branches predicts the same identity (Test all rows, Test S2, fit-row OOF), plus the share with >= 3 of 4 agreeing and with 4 of 4 agreeing
label_free_primary.test_cluster_purity: k-means k=20 partition of all 19218 Test session2 rows in the frozen baseline EEG PCA space (E232 flow, seed 20261117+20, 60 Lloyd iterations); micro purity of the candidate's predicted identities over ALL S2 rows (primary, gate-independent) and over the accepted rows at each gate
label_free_primary.coverage: distinct predicted identities among the accepted Test rows; the full identity distribution is written to results.json

gate_metrics: S2 acceptance at the S1 >= 0.95 gate

decision_rule.identity: a fusion candidate is FROZEN if its closed-set LOSO macro-F1 >= eeg_only macro-F1 AND its Test k=20 purity over all S2 rows >= eeg_only purity - 0.005 (the 0.5 pp tolerance is fixed here, before the run). Tie-break: higher LOSO macro-F1, then higher purity, then higher train OOF macro-F1.
decision_rule.degenerate_exclusion: a candidate whose Test predictions are identical to eeg_only row for row is reported but cannot be adopted: it carries no image information, so it cannot support the claim that image branches help. vote_weighted is such a case by algebra (EEG 0.5 >= 3 * 1/6, plus the EEG d1 tie-break).
decision_rule.gate: the agreement gate is FROZEN if its S2 acceptance at S1 >= 0.95 is > 0.8776 (the E237 result).
decision_rule.official_note: Official C / RA / ASafeR and the official identity macro-F1 on Test are N/A: Test has no identity labels. Every F1 in this report is a train-domain closed-set value (LOSO fold-in or inner-OOF), never a Test value.

limitations: Test has no identity labels: all F1 numbers are train-domain (LOSO fold-in / inner 5-block OOF). The closed-set F1 and the Test cluster purity measure different things and can disagree.
Only 7 image types have both Train and Test pixel caches; GAF / MTF / spectrogram / DINOv3 exist only for Train and are unusable here.
Test has been inspected repeatedly since E65; every S2 number carries a repeated-inspection bias. All weights, ranks, entropy definitions and decision rules were written in this file before the run.
E232 showed session and registration status are confounded (S1 = 5 unregistered subjects, S2 = 20 enrolled users); alignment uses session only as a batch key and never to decide an identity.
The mean alignment and the S1-quantile gate are transductive: they use unlabelled statistics of the batch being scored.

The identity votes are nearest-prototype decisions in a 96-d space; the image branches can only re-rank the same 20 enrolled identities, so fusion cannot create identity information that no branch has.

decision.degeneracy_note: vote_weighted is algebraically identical to eeg_only: EEG holds 0.5 of the vote and the three image branches hold 1/6 each, so 0.5 >= 3 * 1/6 and the EEG d1 tie-break decides every tie. It is reported but excluded from adoption because it carries no image information.

agreement_component.note: AUC of -vote entropy (higher = all four branches agree) as a standalone known/unknown ranker; 0.5 means the agreement carries no information.

gate_score_fused.note: E237 fuse_zscore_50_50 Test score (control); LOSO path rebuilt from the frozen E235 fold scores and the image fold scores

gate_agreement.note: G = 0.5 * P(fused z) + 0.5 * (1 - P(vote entropy)); P = per-task percentile inside the scored population (Test for Test, per-fold eval rows for LOSO), ties mid-rank. Both components are monotone transforms of their own values, so the composition changes nothing but the mixing scale.

gate_sweep.note: curve only; no operating point is chosen from it

submission.note: label 0 = rejected at the S1>=0.95 gate; Test has no identity labels so the official C / identity macro-F1 are N/A
